description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

                  id="Definitions_ViennaNightRun"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ViennaNightRun">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Participant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Preparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunFiveKm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeGoal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Train</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckWorkdayTiming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TravelChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TravelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunAndDrinkSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunAtNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Drink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunAndDrinkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FitnessGadgets" name="Fitness gadgets">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeasureTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Preparation" name="Prepare for participation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select a starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlock_EnterInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInformation" name="Enter information into the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlock_EnterInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterInfo_RunFiveKm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunFiveKm" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterInfo_RunFiveKm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Train_RunFiveKm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunFiveKm_MeasureTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeasureTime" name="Measure the time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunFiveKm_MeasureTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MeasureTime_TimeGoal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeGoal" name="Completed in less than 25 minutes?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MeasureTime_TimeGoal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TimeGoal_Achieved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TimeGoal_NotAchieved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Train" name="Train">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TimeGoal_NotAchieved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Train_RunFiveKm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get the starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TimeGoal_Achieved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GetNumber_CheckTiming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWorkdayTiming" name="Find out whether to go from home or leave from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GetNumber_CheckTiming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckTiming_TravelChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TravelChoice" name="More than one hour between workday end and starting time?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckTiming_TravelChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelChoice_FromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelChoice_FromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go there from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelChoice_FromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromHome_TravelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelChoice_FromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromWork_TravelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TravelMerge" name="Continue after travel choice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromHome_TravelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromWork_TravelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelMerge_RunDrinkSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunAndDrinkSplit" name="Run and drink at the same time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelMerge_RunDrinkSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Run</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Drink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunAtNightRun" name="Run at the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Run</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Drink" name="Drink">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Drink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunAndDrinkJoin" name="Running and drinking complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive the final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveTime_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveTime_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectBlock" sourceRef="StartEvent_Preparation" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlock_EnterInfo" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Task_EnterInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInfo_RunFiveKm" sourceRef="Task_EnterInformation" targetRef="Task_RunFiveKm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunFiveKm_MeasureTime" sourceRef="Task_RunFiveKm" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeasureTime_TimeGoal" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_TimeGoal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimeGoal_Achieved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeGoal" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">timeInMinutes < 25</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimeGoal_NotAchieved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeGoal" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Train_RunFiveKm" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Task_RunFiveKm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GetNumber_CheckTiming" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CheckWorkdayTiming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckTiming_TravelChoice" sourceRef="Task_CheckWorkdayTiming" targetRef="Gateway_TravelChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelChoice_FromHome" name="More than one hour" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelChoice" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">minutesBetweenWorkdayEndAndStartingTime > 60</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelChoice_FromWork" name="One hour or less" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelChoice" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromHome_TravelMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_TravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromWork_TravelMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_TravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelMerge_RunDrinkSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunAndDrinkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RunAndDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_RunAtNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_RunAndDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_Drink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_RunDrinkJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunAtNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunAndDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_RunAndDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RunAndDrinkJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTime_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_InformationSources">
      <bpmn:text>Some information is entered into the app; some information is collected by fitness gadgets.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_AppEntry_InfoSources" sourceRef="Task_EnterInformation" targetRef="TextAnnotation_InformationSources"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_TimeMeasurement_InfoSources" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="TextAnnotation_InformationSources"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
